people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,
translations.bsb: And so to speak, Levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through Abraham.
translations.kjv: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
translations.asv: And, so to say, through Abraham even Levi, who receiveth tithes, hath paid tithes;
